title: Faraway LOD Destruction — Fabric Mountains Destroy/Dissolve via LOD
role: P1 Faraway Mother dissolution: mounts crumble/dither as Tension rises, LOD3 impostor is destroyed state. Tension-driven, shares HorizonEat scalar at horizon.
parent: FarawayMother_CelestialSilk et al in specs/lookdev/optical_lod_manifest.v1.json (11 assets, 4 tiers)
thesis: Destruction is NOT a Chaos sim at runtime for vista. It is LOD state + dither dissolve + WPO fade + opacity clip. LOD0 is intact close, LOD3 is crumbled impostor nothing. Dither hides transition. Tension picks how much has crumbled.

LOD0_MicroRelief_CloseRange.destruction: 0% — full parallax, micro folds via POM32, WPO macro+micro 100%, no dither, mask 1.0

LOD1_MidFrequency_AdaptivePOM.destruction: 25% — half parallax, wpo softened, stipple begins at edges via Bayer 0.1

LOD2_MacroSilhouette_ToksvigStable.destruction: 60% — no POM, Toksvig kills shimmer, WPO only macro swell 30%, Bayer dither 0.35, rim blooms to hold silhouette

LOD3_VistaImpostor_ZeroShimmer.destruction: 100% — impostor crumble, dither clip destroys, WPO 0, height displaces none, only macro normal + rim, then alpha->0 with HorizonEat

destruction_operators.name: Dithered destruction via Bayer + BlueNoise + TemporalAA jitter
destruction_operators.nodes: MF_LODDitheredDestruction (material function): Sample T_Bayer8x8 (screen-aligned), T_BlueNoise64x64 (world), TemporalAAJitter (frame), DitherValue = Bayer*0.5+Blue*0.5 + jitter*0.08. Clip: OpacityMask = DitherValue > (Tension * DestructionMask * HorizonEatLerp). Forces dithered stipple before hard pop.
destruction_operators.mask: DestructionMask: vertex color R (ridge=0.9, valley=0.2) * VDM.A (pleat crests) * HeightMask (altitude>threshold). So ridges crumble first, valley floor lasts.

destruction_operators.name: WPO resonance scale fade (MF_FabricMountainWPO contract)
destruction_operators.formula: WPO_Total = Macro*wp0 + Medium*wp0.75 + Micro*wp0*HCym + Wind. wp0 = WPO_Resonance_Scale per LOD (1.0->0.75->0.3->0.0). At LOD3, no vertex moves — flat impostor.
destruction_operators.tension_mod: WPO_Resonance_Scale *= (1 + BeatPulse*0.6) at LOD0, but *= (1 - Tension*0.8) at LOD2+ (tension stills distant cloth — dread calms wind).
destruction_operators.vdm: VDM xyz offset = VDM.r*Scale.x*T+ VDM.g*Scale.y*B+ VDM.b*Scale.z*N; masked * LOD fade (0 at LOD3) — see klein_veil_manifest vdm_encoding.

destruction_operators.name: Parallax occlusion + Toksvig + rim preservation
destruction_operators.lod0: POM32 with 1024 height reads — crevices deep.
destruction_operators.lod1: POM16 — adaptive step halves, still reads at 30m.
destruction_operators.lod2: POM0 — flat, Toksvig 0.75 smooths mip-banded normals, rim 1.4 restores edge read without parallax.
destruction_operators.lod3: POM0, Toksvig 1.0, rim 1.8 — impostor with only macro normal + grazing Fresnel. Iridescence LUT still ticks via BeatPulse for Moon-haze shimmer before erase.

destruction_operators.name: Niagara dust/fiber emission at destroy
destruction_operators.system: NS_FarawayMother_DustDrift (Tier C): spawn where Dither clip just passed, velocity = Tension vector field + wind, rate = Tension * HorizonEat * BeatPulse. Single-writer safe: reads NPC_BeatPulse only.
destruction_operators.budget: Spawn only on dither transition band (0.4<HorizonEat<0.8), kill after LOD3 alpha 0 — prevents overdraw.

tension_driven.bus: WorldField.Tension 0..1 (same as HorizonEatAmount at horizon). UMelodiaAudioReactivePresentationSubsystem sole writer. MPC_Melodia_Palette.BeatPulse/BassIntensity/Mid read-only via UMelodiaCymaticsSubsystem.

mapping.0.0-0.3: Pristine — only LOD1 stipple, no real loss. FrillValley (T<0.40) still intact.
mapping.0.3-0.6: Unease — LOD2 WPO half, ridges crumble, high WeaveRidge (T>0.60) first to go. Player still can Wayfold across.
mapping.0.6-0.9: Collapse — LOD3 impostor dither 50-90%, macro only, filter corridors visible. Mother silhouette implied by haze only (per production sheet Body Map: distant limbs = fog).
mapping.0.9-1.0: Eaten — LOD3 alpha 0, horizon gone. Only heart gate (MEL_mother_heart_gate) persists as anchor (Mara Anchor radius: 1m stays 1m).

per_biome.WeaveRidge: T>0.60, avg 0.96 — crushes FIRST. Tension threshold 0.35. Material MI_T_FarawayMother_Gown_CelestialSilkJacquard crumble mask boosted.
per_biome.LaceCanopy: T 0.40-0.60, avg 0.87 — mid. Threshold 0.50, translucent lace hangs longer (Opacity map erodes).
per_biome.FrillValley: T<0.40, avg ~0.32-0.89 (mixed) — LAST. Floor MI_T_FarawayMother_Corset_GildedAcanthusBrocade persists until HorizonEat 0.85.
per_biome.ResonantSeamWay: |Chladni|<0.12 corridor — NEVER fully crumbles, becomes the Wayfold path to horizon mouth. Heart gate threshold 0.95 (quest-locked).

DestructionAmount 0..1 (Faraway-specific, drives dither threshold — can be HorizonEat*0.9 for coupling)

Ops: TensionCull (density *= 1 - Tension*BiomeFactor), DitherSpawn (keep/discard via BlueNoise), AdvectTowardSeamWay (points near destruction slide to nearest |Chladni|<0.12), HeightAware raycast.

pcg_ex.impostor: HLOD candidates: Nanite terrain stays, but kitbash ISMs at LOD3 swap to impostor billboard + crumble mask. PCG keeps entry/exit Wayfold pair inside SeamWay.

houdini.vdm: VDM_FabricMountain_Save: VDM fade 1.0->0.0 LOD0->LOD3 (POM32->0, Toksvig 0->1, dither). Cymatic Chladni (3,5) freq fed to VDM fold via foldFreq = baseFreq + BassIntensity*2.0.
houdini.hda: Tools/Houdini/vdm_fabric_mountains/vdm_fabric_baker.py already bakes VDM; destruction extension adds DestructionMask bake (vertex color R) in same pass. No new HDA needed for core — add HDM_LodDestructionMask subnetwork if chaining.

weave_with_horizon_eater: HorizonEatAmount is the Faraway destruction envelope at horizon distance. Close mountains destroy via Tension first (local dread). Horizon mountains destroy via HorizonEat (eater eating the Mother). At full eater (1.0), only SeamWay Heart Gate remains as the Seam — the veil seam that outlives the mountain.
